name: randomizedBlockFit
title: Fit Mixed Linear Model with 2 Error Components (randomized block matrices)

origin.description: Matrix interface alias of mixedModel2Fit for randomized block models.
origin.usage: randomizedBlockFit(y, X, Z, w=NULL, only.varcomp=FALSE, tol=1e-6, maxit=50, trace=FALSE)
origin.value: List with variance components, standard errors, and fixed coefficients.
origin.example: randomizedBlockFit(y, X, Z) on the petrol data matrices.

translation.description: Matrix interface alias of mixed_model2_fit for randomized block models.
translation.usage: randomized_block_fit(y, x, z, w=None, only_varcomp=False, tol=1e-6, maxit=50, trace=False)
translation.value: Dict with variance components, standard errors, and fixed coefficients.
translation.example: randomized_block_fit(y, x, z) on the petrol data matrices.
